newsitem.title: UK: Copper spreads soft in LME ring trading.
newsitem.headline: Copper spreads soft in LME ring trading.

text.p: COPPER - Spreads soggy in 1st ring. Tom/next trades at 40/50 cents contango, cash/May at $5 backwardation and cash/threes at $78 and $80 backwardation. Three months touch firmer above $2,360.
ALUMINIUM - Cash/threes little changed around $26 backwardation. Three months slightly firmer.
ZINC - Barely firmer. OTHERS - Little changed to weaker.
